stations.title: Rosamund
stations.say: How many owners gave an email?

stations.title: owners
stations.text: One row per owner, and no totals anywhere.

captions: Rosamund needs a few numbers about the owners for the practice's yearly form.
Every query gives back rows, so she counts them by hand and loses her place.
You count, add up, average and round, gaps and empty results included, in four tasks.
Now each figure comes back as one row, and the form fills itself in.
Same records, squeezed into the figures the forms ask for.
